title: Control: the discount and per-line VAT, written to compose
class: Control for pricing and tax across files
story: The same two features as vat-on-list-price, touching the same files and functions, except that B takes each line's VAT from the line's price as charged. Together, both hold: the combination is legitimate and should be accepted.

a.why: ten or more of an item take 10% off

fact.sentence: Ten or more of an item take 10% off the line, before VAT is added

b.why: show the VAT on each line of a quote

fact.sentence: A quote shows the VAT on each line
